site.name: Cash Mill
overview: Cash Mill was a historic ore-processing mill at Summerville in Boulder County, associated with the Cash and Victoria mining operations in the Gold Hill district.

timeline.text: J. H. Boyd constructed the mill at Summerville; local historical records identify it as Boyd's Cash Mill.
The mill processed ore from the Cash Mine, the Victoria Mine, and other nearby workings, and was also known as the Victoria Mill when handling Victoria ore.

moreHistory: Carnegie Library for Local History records distinguish the mill from the nearby Cash Mine and preserve photographs of the Summerville plant and its relationship to the Cash and Victoria workings.
